title: GuruMeter
description: Guru Meter is an advanced square-boundary detection plugin for Paper 1.21.11 with WorldEdit integration and real-time perimeter security.
body:
🔥 Guru Meter – Advanced Boundary Detection System

Guru Meter is a powerful perimeter security plugin designed for high-security Minecraft servers.
It transforms any selected area into a monitored zone with real-time scanning and detection mechanics.

Using WorldEdit selection, server administrators can define a square boundary that activates an intelligent detection system.

When players approach the boundary:

⚡ A live scanning system activates

👁 Detection status is displayed on screen

🚨 Unauthorized movement beyond the zone results in instant elimination


The plugin includes a whitelist system that changes detection behavior based on player status, creating dynamic and cinematic gameplay scenarios.

Perfect for:

SMP story-based servers

Military or restricted zones

Secret base protection

High-security event areas


Built for Paper 1.21.11, fully compatible with Spigot, and developed using safe API methods without NMS.
